gold_construction: World Bank Pink Sheet monthly gold 1833-01-31→2026-10-31

notes.MREIT: NLY (Annaly) is a single-name agency mREIT, not the NAREIT mortgage REIT index.
notes.GOLD: World Bank Pink Sheet monthly average USD/oz (datasets/gold-prices). Month-average, not LBMA PM fix. Gold pays no dividend.
notes.TBILL: Kenneth French monthly RF (1-month T-bill return), TB3MS yield conversion only to extend the tail.
notes.INTL: VGTSX is ACWI ex-US (developed + emerging), slightly broader than EAFE.
